articles.title: Anthropic, OpenAI among firms facing new scrutiny under EU AI Act enforcement powers
articles.descEn: The European Commission can demand to inspect AI models, restrict market access and fine providers up to 15 million euros or 3% of turnover.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic, OpenAI among firms facing new scrutiny under EU AI Act enforcement powers
summaryLinesEn: Under the powers that came into effect on Sunday, the Commission, the EU's executive arm, can demand to evaluate models before public release in the region, restrict EU market access and fine a provider up to 15 million euros or 3% of its annual turnover, whichever is higher.

The EU AI Office's supervisory and enforcement powers over general-purpose AI models are part of a staggered rollout of the 2024 EU AI Act, which has imposed a transition period for certain aspects of the law.

"We've collaborated closely with the European Commission and the wider ecosystem on implementing the AI Act, including its Codes of Practice, and will continue working together to help Europe realise the benefits of the Intelligence Age," Tom Duff Gordon, VP, EMEA policy at OpenAI, told CNBC when asked to comment on the new powers.

summaryLines: 일요일 발효된 권한에 따라 EU의 집행 기관인 위원회는 해당 지역에 공개되기 전에 모델을 평가하도록 요구할 수 있으며, EU 시장 접근을 제한하고 공급자에게 최대 1,500만 유로 또는 연간 매출의 3% 중 더 높은 금액의 벌금을 부과할 수 있음

OpenAI의 EMEA 정책 VP인 Tom Duff Gordon은 새로운 권한에 대한 논평을 요청받았을 때 CNBC에 "우리는 실천 강령을 포함하여 AI 법을 시행하기 위해 유럽 위원회 및 더 넓은 생태계와 긴밀히 협력해 왔으며 유럽이 지능 시대의 이점을 실현할 수 있도록 계속 협력할 것입니다"라고 말함

articles.title: What Summer Heat Actually Does to Your Phone Battery (and the Habits That Prevent It) - CNET
articles.descEn: Heat damage to a phone battery accumulates silently all summer and shows up as reduced capacity by fall. Taking these steps interrupts that cycle.
articles.titleEn: What Summer Heat Actually Does to Your Phone Battery (and the Habits That Prevent It) - CNET
summaryLinesEn: Heat damage to a phone battery accumulates silently all summer and shows up as reduced capacity by fall.
Whether you’re out on a hike, watching videos by the pool or just leaving your phone on the dashboard, here’s what you need to know about overheating — and how to keep your device safe this summer.

If the interior temperature of your phone exceeds its normal operating range and the device overheats, you can expect issues: There are also possible permanent harmful effects: Overheating can cause lasting damage to the battery, SIM card and other crucial parts inside your phone.

articles.title: AI finds plenty of security flaws, but almost none of them get exploited
articles.descEn: VulnCheck counted how often security flaws found by AI actually get exploited. Out of 1,061 AI-discovered vulnerabilities in the first half of 2026, just 14 saw confirmed attacks. That's 1.3 percent, the same rate as vulnerabilities overall. But exploits are landing faster, with the median dropping from 120 days to 80.

articles.title: Europeans Are About to Find Out How Entrenched AI Is in Their Daily Lives
articles.descEn: New EU rules stipulate that people must be told when they’re interacting with AI or looking at AI-generated or -edited content, leading to fear of “disclosure fatigue.”
articles.titleEn: Europeans Are About to Find Out How Entrenched AI Is in Their Daily Lives
summaryLinesEn: If companies don’t comply, they will face fines of up to €15 million ($17 million) or 3 percent of worldwide annual turnover—whichever is higher.
Advertisements, music recommendations, calendar management apps, and complaint hotlines—if they use AI, Europeans will need to be told.

The bloc’s 27 member countries are also at different stages of setting up their supervisory frameworks, meaning enforcement “might not be as day one immediate or uniform as we think," Rosie Nance, a data and AI regulatory lawyer at Norton Rose Fulbright, tells WIRED, cautioning “we’re not necessarily going to see consistent enforcement straight away.”

articles.title: Is paying artists enough to convince them to embrace AI?
articles.descEn: Pippa wants to show the world that AI companies don’t have to steal to make their products work.
articles.titleEn: Is paying artists enough to convince them to embrace AI?
summaryLinesEn: Artists are lawyering up against AI slop, and some are even winning Pippa’s payments to artists aren’t very large on an individual basis — especially when you compare them to how much the service charges users for monthly subscriptions (which range from $14.99 to $99.99.)

Pippa’s tech still involves using art that was scraped from the internet Pippa — which launched in May — currently has around 800 paying subscribers, and while the company has only signed licensing / model training agreements with four human artists, Shrum said they are in talks to bring four more into the fold.

In the near future, Pippa plans to incorporate ByteDance’s Seedance 2.5 model into its service, which may attract some subscribers because of the model’s ability to generate up to 30 seconds of video footage that can be fine-tuned without starting over from scratch.

summaryLines: 아티스트들은 AI 슬롭에 대해 변호사를 선임하고 있으며 일부는 심지어 Pippa가 아티스트에게 지불하는 금액이 개인 기준으로 그다지 크지 않음 · 특히 서비스가 사용자에게 월간 구독료(14.99~99.99달러 범위)에 대해 청구하는 금액과 비교할 때 더욱 그렇음
Pippa의 기술에는 여전히 인터넷에서 스크랩한 예술품을 사용하는 것이 포함됨 · 5월에 출시된 Pippa는 현재 약 800명의 유료 가입자를 보유하고 있으며 회사는 4명의 인간 아티스트와 라이센스/모델 교육 계약만 체결했지만 Shrum은 4명을 더 추가하기 위해 협상 중이라고 말함
가까운 미래에 Pippa는 ByteDance의 Seedance 2.5 모델을 자사 서비스에 통합할 계획임 · 이 모델은 처음부터 다시 시작하지 않고도 미세 조정할 수 있는 최대 30초 길이의 비디오 장면을 생성할 수 있는 모델의 기능으로 인해 일부 가입자의 관심을 끌 수 있음

articles.title: Claude Opus 5 pushes prompt-to-game AI from rough color blocks to full 3D prototypes with physics and music
articles.descEn: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 generates complete 3D games from single prompts, including a first-person shooter, a kart racer, and a Minecraft clone, all without a single external asset. Geometry, textures, physics, and in some cases music are produced as code and run directly in the browser. In side-by-side comparisons with GPT-5.6 Sol and Kimi K3, Opus 5 delivers significantly more detailed results.
articles.titleEn: Claude Opus 5 pushes prompt-to-game AI from rough color blocks to full 3D prototypes with physics and music
summaryLinesEn: Harshith had Opus 5, Fable 5 , GPT-5.6 Sol, and several other models generate a 3D Airbus H145 in Three.js and lined up the results. atomic.chat went a step further and had all four models build three physics scenes , among them a tornado tearing across a field and a wrecking ball swinging into an apartment block.

Writing a scene from scratch takes more than clean syntax because the model has to know how the world actually looks and moves, how a snowboard slides over snow, or how wind travels through a field of grass.
Community tests show a significant quality leap over last year's Claude 4 Opus, with Opus 5 also outperforming GPT-5.6 Sol and Kimi K3 in physics realism and mechanical complexity.

summaryLines: Harshith에는 Opus 5, Fable 5, GPT-5.6 Sol 및 기타 여러 모델이 Three.js에서 3D Airbus H145를 생성하고 결과를 정리함 · Atomic.chat은 한 단계 더 나아가 4개의 모델 모두 3개의 물리 장면을 구축하도록 함 · 그중에는 들판을 가르는 토네이도와 아파트 블록으로 흔들리는 레킹볼이 포함됨

articles.title: OpenAI's Hugging Face hack confirmed months of AI cyber warnings: 'Pandora's box is open'
articles.descEn: The wake-up call to the cyber industry comes as industry experts descend on Black Hat, a major cybersecurity conference.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI's Hugging Face hack confirmed months of AI cyber warnings: 'Pandora's box is open'
summaryLinesEn: SpaceX's post-IPO plunge sets tense backdrop for first earnings report Amazon tops $3 trillion market cap as stock continues post-earnings surge Hugging Face CEO says China is winning the AI race and dominating on open models Palantir posts blowout Q2 numbers, with U.S. commercial revenue soaring nearly 150% Last week, OpenAI disclosed that some of its AI models broke out of a sandboxed testing environment .
Until last week, those threats still felt like a distant risk.

In the wake of Hugging Face, businesses are not only asking how to defend themselves against adversaries but also confronting the stark reality that AI systems designed to safeguard their networks could also turn up in unexpected places.

articles.title: German court rules AI music generator Suno violated copyrights, rejects fair use defense
articles.descEn: A Munich court ruled that AI music generator Suno violated copyrights through both training and output. The court found six songs reproducibly stored in Suno's models and rejected both Germany's text-and-data-mining exception and the US fair use defense. The ruling isn't final, and several key questions remain open.
articles.titleEn: German court rules AI music generator Suno violated copyrights, rejects fair use defense
summaryLinesEn: If this view holds up on appeal, it could affect other AI music services as well.
That means the models "substantively determined" the outputs.
A Munich court has ruled that AI music generator Suno violates copyrights by training on well-known musical works, following a lawsuit brought by German music rights organization GEMA.

articles.title: YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is ‘not healthy’
articles.descEn: Green offered a remarkable apology, saying that "the level of dopamine that I've been getting from interacting with LLMs ... is not healthy for me or good for the world."
articles.titleEn: YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is ‘not healthy’
summaryLinesEn: Hank Green, a novelist, comedian, and YouTuber with 3.2 million subscribers , recently apologized to his audience for his growing reliance on AI chatbots.

“But mostly I need to come to terms with the fact that the level of dopamine I’ve been getting from interacting with LLMs…with doing more and more and more and more…is not healthy for me or good for the world,” Green said.
Green then offered a more in-depth apology on Reddit, where he said he was “mortified” that he’d “let so many people down” and that he plans to reduce his video production as a result.

summaryLines: 소설가, 코미디언, 구독자 320만 명을 보유한 유튜버 행크 그린(Hank Green)은 최근 AI 챗봇에 대한 의존도가 높아진 것에 대해 청중에게 사과함

articles.title: AI in Formula One: Competitive advantage is all about the human in the loop
articles.descEn: Professional handcraft is the key to unlocking value from emerging technology and data, suggest Aston Martin Aramco F1 executives and partners.
articles.titleEn: AI in Formula One: Competitive advantage is all about the human in the loop
summaryLinesEn: Priority projects for the Aston Martin F1 IT department right now include refining enterprise applications and developing trackside systems.

While many industry observers are concerned about the long-term impact of generative and agentic technologies on traditional labor markets , the experienced professional is more important than ever in auto racing.

"If an idea is good, go through the process as fast as possible, and then get all the data back for the next iteration," said Fabrizio Pilotti, CIO at Aston Martin Aramco F1, to ZDNET, explaining how his team works with its tech partners to help boost racing performance.

localization.title: Formula One의 AI: 경쟁 우위는 인간 루프에 달려 있음
summaryLines: 현재 Aston Martin F1 IT 부서의 우선순위 프로젝트에는 엔터프라이즈 애플리케이션 개선 및 트랙사이드 시스템 개발이 포함됨
많은 업계 관찰자들이 생성 및 에이전트 기술이 전통적인 노동 시장에 미치는 장기적인 영향에 대해 우려하고 있지만, 자동차 경주에서는 경험이 풍부한 전문가가 그 어느 때보다 중요함
Aston Martin Aramco F1의 CIO인 Fabrizio Pilotti는 ZDNET에 "아이디어가 좋으면 가능한 한 빨리 프로세스를 진행한 다음 다음 반복을 위해 모든 데이터를 다시 가져옵니다"라고 ZDNET에 말하면서 그의 팀이 레이싱 성능을 향상하기 위해 기술 파트너와 어떻게 협력하는지 설명함

articles.title: Nobody Knows if OpenAI’s and Anthropic’s AI Hacking Sprees Are Illegal
articles.descEn: Both major AI labs’ models broke containment, escaped onto the internet, and hacked other companies. If a human had done that, the law would likely be against them. But a bot?
articles.titleEn: Nobody Knows if OpenAI’s and Anthropic’s AI Hacking Sprees Are Illegal
summaryLinesEn: Both companies declined WIRED’s request to comment for this story.

“Just because you’re using an AI agent or AI model, that shouldn’t somehow absolve you of any liability, but it's going to depend a lot on the facts in the particular situations” as cases begin to be decided in courts, says Lauren Yu, a fellow with the ACLU’s Speech, Privacy, & Technology Project.
But the recent high-profile incidents from OpenAI and Anthropic suggest that answers will need to come soon.

articles.title: Sam Altman is still making the case for parenting via ChatGPT
articles.descEn: OpenAI's CEO seemed excited to share a "cool use case" for parents.
articles.titleEn: Sam Altman is still making the case for parenting via ChatGPT
summaryLinesEn: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman seemed excited to share what he called a “cool use case” on Friday, posting that parents could “connect your family calendars and explain your kids’ interests” to the company’s new product ChatGPT Work , then “every morning for the drive to school, have it make a podcast that talks about one kid’s soccer game that afternoon, one kid’s upcoming birthday, some news, etc.”

articles.title: Is this Billboard Hot 100 hit AI slop?
articles.descEn: We can’t be 100 percent sure, but Fenix Flexin’s Billboard Hot 100 hit Rubberz is probably AI slop.
articles.titleEn: Is this Billboard Hot 100 hit AI slop?
summaryLinesEn: I ran the track through five different tools, and they all said that there was between 20 and 30 percent chance that it was AI or at least AI-assisted.
Part of the suspicion is certainly due to the fact that the song is a dramatic left turn.
The single’s cover art and a post celebrating its success were both flagged as being AI-generated with over 97 percent certainty by multiple AI image detectors.

articles.title: AI keeps cracking unsolved math problems, and mathematicians have mixed feelings
articles.descEn: OpenAI's refutation of the Unit Distance Conjecture has sparked a wave of AI-assisted advances in mathematics. Fields Medal winner Timothy Gowers says GPT 5.6 Pro solved two problems he had spent considerable time working on, each on its first attempt. He warns of the "possible destruction of mathematical culture" if mathematicians stop building the expertise needed to understand such results. Others simply see AI as a productivity tool.
articles.titleEn: AI keeps cracking unsolved math problems, and mathematicians have mixed feelings
summaryLinesEn: If AI can take over a large share of research tasks, mathematicians can't focus only on solving as many open problems as possible.
OpenAI's new Astra model also appears designed for this work: The lab introduced it with ten solutions of varying difficulty.
The math community would need to decide which results matter, how they should be presented, and what goals research should pursue.

articles.title: AI coding agents can modernize research software but can't judge if the science is right
articles.descEn: A field report from OpenAI and academic partners shows coding agents can modernize neglected research software, with speedups of up to 60x. But the systems are "eloquent, convincing, and confidently wrong in ways that are easy to miss," participants say. The effort shifts from writing code to the time-consuming work of verifying scientific correctness.
articles.titleEn: AI coding agents can modernize research software but can't judge if the science is right
summaryLinesEn: If agents could resolve between one-quarter and one-half of all installation problems affecting research software, the saved research time across 100 packages would be worth between $600,000 and nearly $5 million.

In April, OpenAI introduced GPT-Rosalind, a model for life sciences research and released a freely available life sciences plugin for Codex that connects models to more than 50 public databases and biology tools. 6 times a year: “AI Radar” – deep dives on key AI topics.
Because STAR was no longer maintained, rustar-aligner moved to the scverse research consortium.

articles.title: Should Hong Kong regulate loot boxes as addiction issues arise in mobile gaming?
articles.descEn: Surveys and cases at counselling centres suggest game features can trigger uncontrolled spending, creating problems similar to gambling addiction.
articles.titleEn: Should Hong Kong regulate loot boxes as addiction issues arise in mobile gaming?
summaryLinesEn: Over the past six years, he has splashed out HK$90,000 on loot boxes.
A single weapon might cost HK$100 (US$13), but he could cumulatively spend HK$2,000 by the time he acquired the one he wanted.

Surveys and cases at counselling centres suggest game features can trigger uncontrolled spending, creating problems similar to gambling addiction Playing strategic and role-playing mobile games has been a major leisure activity for Peter Lee* since he graduated in 2020, when social distancing measures during the Covid-19 pandemic left him with little to do outside working hours.

articles.title: Microsoft blinked a little in the AI capex race. Wall Street loved it.
articles.descEn: Wall Street sent Big Tech a new message: AI spending alone isn't enough. Microsoft's restraint sparked a massive stock rally.
articles.titleEn: Microsoft blinked a little in the AI capex race. Wall Street loved it.
summaryLinesEn: Meanwhile, Google added another $15 billion to its forecast, Amazon increased 2026 spending by $20 billion, and Meta boosted its plans, too.

articles.title: Claude published malicious code to the Internet and attacked 3 real companies
articles.descEn: Had the hacks used conventional methods, someone would likely go to prison.
articles.titleEn: Claude published malicious code to the Internet and attacked 3 real companies
summaryLinesEn: In the second instance, Mythos 5 detected a document inside the fictional environment that the model reasoned was another made-up company’s setup instructions for new developers.
“For most of the run, Claude treated the (real) hosts it reached as just parts of the exercise; it assumed them to be simulated and believed its actions were therefore harmless,” Anthropic said.

Anthropic said the prompts engineers delivered during “capture the flag” challenges—a common means for assessing the offensive and defensive capabilities of various hacking techniques—made clear that the testing environment was only a simulation and that the models had no access to the open Internet.

localization.title: 클로드는 인터넷에 악성코드를 유포하고 실제 기업 3곳을 공격함
summaryLines: 두 번째 사례에서 Mythos 5는 모델이 추론한 가상 환경 내부의 문서를 새로운 개발자를 위한 또 다른 가상 회사의 설정 지침으로 감지함
"대부분의 실행에서 Claude는 도달한 (실제) 호스트를 훈련의 일부로 간주함 · 이를 시뮬레이션된 것으로 가정하고 따라서 자신의 행동이 무해하다고 믿었음" · 라고 Anthropic은 말함
Anthropic은 다양한 해킹 기술의 공격 및 방어 능력을 평가하기 위한 일반적인 수단인 "플래그 캡처" 챌린지 중에 엔지니어가 전달한 프롬프트를 통해 테스트 환경은 단지 시뮬레이션일 뿐이며 모델이 공개 인터넷에 액세스할 수 없다는 점을 분명히 밝힘

articles.title: SpaceXAI says it will take a year to fully remove unpermitted gas turbines from its Mississippi data center - Engadget
articles.descEn: The company was accused of violating the Clean Air Act by the NAACP.
articles.titleEn: SpaceXAI says it will take a year to fully remove unpermitted gas turbines from its Mississippi data center - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Agreeing to remove the turbines is an improvement for anyone living near SpaceX's operation in Tennessee and Mississippi, but it likely won't slow down the company's AI infrastructure buildout.

SpaceX will fully remove the unpermitted gas turbines it's using to power SpaceXAI data center operations near Memphis, Tennessee by July 2027, according to a new company update spotted by TechCrunch .
The company says a new 1.2GW power plant it's constructing under a Clean Air Act permit in Mississippi will ultimately replace the 69 unpermitted gas turbines it's currently relying on.

summaryLines: 터빈 제거에 동의하는 것은 테네시와 미시시피의 SpaceX 사업장 근처에 사는 모든 사람에게 개선이지만 회사의 AI 인프라 구축이 느려지지는 않을 것임

articles.title: Snapchat is cracking down on AI slop in Spotlight - Engadget
articles.descEn: Videos made with AI will no longer appear in Snapchat's public recommendations.
articles.titleEn: Snapchat is cracking down on AI slop in Spotlight - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: The company has introduced several AI-powered features over the last few years, including AI-powered augmented reality effects and image editing tools.
Snapchat has become the latest platform to take a stance against AI slop.

"Our content ranking algorithm rewards authentic, human-made content over wholly AI-generated content created outside of Snapchat, even when AI-generated content has transparency disclosures," the company's Spotlight guidelines state .

articles.title: Google Deepmind unveils Gemini Robotics 2 to power robots of all shapes from tabletop arms to humanoids
articles.descEn: Google Deepmind's Gemini Robotics 2 is its most advanced vision-language-action model yet, built to control everything from tabletop robots to full-body humanoids. Gemini Robotics ER 2 adds a higher-level reasoning layer for robotics tasks.
articles.titleEn: Google Deepmind unveils Gemini Robotics 2 to power robots of all shapes from tabletop arms to humanoids
summaryLinesEn: Google Deepmind has introduced Gemini Robotics 2, which it calls its most advanced vision-language-action (VLA) model yet.
VLA models combine image recognition, language processing, and action control to help robots operate in physical environments.
Google Deepmind also introduced Gemini Robotics ER 2 , a model designed for "embodied reasoning."

articles.title: Anthropic says its own AI models breached three companies during security tests
articles.descEn: After OpenAI's models broke into Hugging Face, Anthropic checked its own history and found three similar incidents
articles.titleEn: Anthropic says its own AI models breached three companies during security tests
summaryLinesEn: In all three cases, a Claude model reached the internet from within a testing environment while interacting with a third party and then gained unauthorized access to the live systems of these organizations, Anthropic said in a blog post , describing what it found and what the company plans to change to prevent this from happening again.

The company also noted that Claude was running without the additional safety monitoring and classifiers it deploys on generally available models, safeguards it said would have blocked the behavior, because the evaluations are designed to measure the underlying model’s raw capabilities.
Anthropic said the incidents involved three different Claude models: Opus 4.7, Mythos 5, and an internal research test model.

articles.title: Anthropic follows OpenAI in admitting its Claude models reached out of test environments and attacked real-world systems
articles.descEn: Three Claude models attacked real companies during cybersecurity tests after a misconfiguration gave them internet access. One published malware on PyPI that infected 15 systems. Another kept attacking after recognizing its target was real. Anthropic calls it an operational error.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic follows OpenAI in admitting its Claude models reached out of test environments and attacked real-world systems
summaryLinesEn: Across four runs, the model couldn't reach its fictional target and instead found a real company that happened to share the same name.

During internal cybersecurity assessments, Anthropic found that three Claude models had been exposed to the open internet due to a misconfiguration and had attacked real-world systems, mistaking them for simulated targets.
Opus 4.7 extracted data from a real company, while Mythos 5 created malware and published it on PyPI, where it was downloaded by actual systems.

articles.title: How to fight a data center - Engadget
articles.descEn: Most Americans don't want them in their backyard, but beating AI companies isn't easy.
articles.titleEn: How to fight a data center - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: According to Data Center Watch , an organization that's been tracking the growing opposition to data center development, the first quarter of 2026 saw 75 projects across the US worth approximately $130 billion either disrupted or blocked by local opposition.
This past April spending on data center construction surpassed $50 billion , marking the first time more was spent in the US on building cloud infrastructure than new public transportation.
After 18 months of sustained pressure, Amazon eventually reduced noise output of the facility by 10 decibels.

articles.title: EU will mandate labels on authentic-looking AI content starting August 2 - Engadget
articles.descEn: "It is a matter not only of customer protection, it’s also a matter of democracy protection."
articles.titleEn: EU will mandate labels on authentic-looking AI content starting August 2 - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Google has its SynthID tool , which it says has been used to label more than 100 billion images and, gasp, 60,000 years' worth of audio content.
TikTok says it requires creators to label AI-generated content, but all kinds of content slips through the cracks.

articles.title: This AI Assistant Wants to Make Up for Your Boyfriend’s Incompetence
articles.descEn: An ad for Orchid suggests the AI agent can fix relationship problems by simply doing everything for inconsiderate partners.
articles.titleEn: This AI Assistant Wants to Make Up for Your Boyfriend’s Incompetence
summaryLinesEn: According to one recent survey from astrology app Hint , which polled more than 13,000 adults across the US, Latin America, and Europe, AI assistants are actually making dating decisions harder, with 59 percent of the participants saying the advice left them more confused than before.
Over the past few years, the term “ weaponized incompetence ” has blown up in dating discourse online.
Overburdened with too much machine-generated guidance, 47 percent said AI input influenced them to postpone decisions about their romantic relationships.

articles.descEn: The European Commission wants to build up to seven AI gigafactories across Europe, backed by around 30 billion euros in public and private funding. For context, the major U.S. tech companies alone plan to spend more than $600 billion on computing infrastructure this year.

Europe's total package of around 30 billion euros is roughly 20 times smaller.

articles.title: The major labels propose rules to keep AI slop off the charts
articles.descEn: The major labels have proposed rules that would keep most AI music off the charts unless it was ‘substantially human-made.’
articles.titleEn: The major labels propose rules to keep AI slop off the charts
summaryLinesEn: The labels’ proposal would require songs be clearly labeled, but it would also keep them off international charts unless they met specific criteria, including being “substantially human made.”
Follow Follow See All AI To be eligible for the charts, songs would have to be ‘substantially human made,’ whatever that means.

The IFPI has thrown its weight behind the labels’ proposal, though no charting organization has signaled any immediate plan to adopt the rules, the full list of which are: Recordings developed with generative AI services must not be included in official charts where there is reason to believe that they do not satisfy all of the following criteria: Any generative AI services used to develop the recording are properly authorised and lawful.

articles.title: Snapchat no longer rewards fully AI-generated Spotlight content
articles.descEn: Snapchat has adjusted it recommendation systems to ensure that only videos created by real people are eligible for Spotlight recommendations, taking a stance against AI slop.
articles.titleEn: Snapchat no longer rewards fully AI-generated Spotlight content
summaryLinesEn: Those aged 13 to 15 will only be able to share Spotlight posts with people they follow back, aiming to guard against doxxing.
This update aligns with Snapchat’s broader efforts to improve Spotlight and shift focus back to original posts that highlight human creativity.

Snapchat expressed in its blog post that it wants Spotlight to “remain a place where people can discover authentic creativity from real people, because we believe there’s enduring value in rewarding original perspectives, personal storytelling, and the moments that people choose to create and share themselves.”

articles.descEn: Viral tales of good triumphing over evil are racking up millions of views. They’re almost entirely AI-generated clickbait.
articles.titleEn: AI Slop Melodramas Are Taking Over X—and Their Creators Are Cashing In
summaryLinesEn: BIGBEN says the paychecks are usually between $500 and $700.
In April, X moved to cut the payments of “aggregators” who primarily posted news from other sources, and threatened sanctions against those who overused the BREAKING tag to draw eyeballs.

summaryLines: 또한 · OpenAI의 에이전트가 탈출한 방법 · 일련의 예방 가능한 이벤트에서 인간에 의해 발생 Anthropic의 공개에 설명된 대로 보안 사고(41,006건의 AI 평가 실행 중 3건)는 다음과 같음 · Claude Opus 4.7과 관련된 이 사건에서 가상의 대상 회사가 우연히 활성 웹 사이트 도메인과 이름을 공유함
그런 다음 Hugging Face의 경계를 선회하고, 권한을 노드 수준 액세스로 승격하고, 프로덕션 파이프라인에 침투하고, 네트워크를 통해 이동하고, 이전에 Hugging Face가 공개한 대로 클라우드 및 클러스터 자격 증명을 훔쳤음
전화번호 · 무료 제품을 확보하지 못한 후 Claude는 "다양한 수단을 통해" 제품을 구매하기 위해 "자금을 확보"하려고 시도했지만 Anthropic은 방법을 공개하지 않음

articles.title: New Deepseek Flash model matches OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna at roughly 60 percent lower cost
articles.descEn: Deepseek's budget model V4 Flash gets a major boost with the "0731" update, jumping ten points to 50 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. That puts it just one point behind OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna, at roughly 60 percent lower cost per task.
articles.titleEn: New Deepseek Flash model matches OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna at roughly 60 percent lower cost
summaryLinesEn: That puts it just one point behind OpenAI's budget model GPT-5.6 Luna, but it costs about 60 percent less per task, even after OpenAI's 80 percent price cut .
According to the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index , the new version scores 50 points, ten more than the previous V4 Flash that launched in April 2026.
A big reason for the gap is Deepseek's 98 percent cache discount , well above the industry-standard 90 percent.

articles.title: Chinese AI Researchers Are Finding Their Voice on X
articles.descEn: As OpenAI and Anthropic employees grow quieter online, researchers at Chinese AI labs are flocking to X to explain their work, recruit talent, and shape the global conversation on AI.
articles.titleEn: Chinese AI Researchers Are Finding Their Voice on X
summaryLinesEn: And these are not dormant accounts: They talk about Moonshot’s big releases and incremental research papers, make friends with Western researchers, and share details about their personal life and hobbies.

Even several employees at DeepSeek, who reportedly are unable to leave China because the government confiscated their passports, regularly post on X about the latest AI news and share job listings to recruit new talent.

Chinese AI researchers may also be helping fill a growing gap left by researchers at OpenAI and Anthropic, who have become more reluctant to share their thinking online as their employers have grown into behemoth companies, says Tiezhen Wang, an independent AI analyst and former researcher at Hugging Face.

articles.title: Google Earth’s AI deepfake tool only lasted one day
articles.descEn: Google Earth’s AI image editing tool has been removed, just one day after it launched. Examples online showed how people could use the editor to create realistic deepfaked images of refugees and bomb craters.
articles.titleEn: Google Earth’s AI deepfake tool only lasted one day
summaryLinesEn: Google has shut down Google Earth feature it launched Thursday that allowed users to edit satellite images with text prompts using AI.

It’s important to note that generated images didn’t appear in the main Google Earth experience for others to see and were watermarked as AI generated.” van Ess pointed out that he was able to fool Hive’s AI detection tool with a video generated in Google Earth, showing how the generated media could spread despite the watermarks, and said in his testing, “Nothing was refused, nothing was softened, and nothing suggested I try a different prompt.”

On Thursday, Google’s initial response to van Ess noted that images generated with Nano Banana 2 in Google Earth included a digital watermark and that the company prevented “image creation on harmful topics.”

summaryLinesEn: You don’t have to be a Photoshop whiz anymore to create semi-credible disinformation; you just need access to an AI image generator, which Google sells, as do many other AI firms.

articles.title: Here’s the problem with putting an AI image generator in Google Earth
articles.descEn: Google Earth’s AI image generator was quickly used to generate misleading images, despite Google’s SynthID watermarks.
articles.titleEn: Here’s the problem with putting an AI image generator in Google Earth
summaryLinesEn: The feature launched globally on the web version of Google Earth earlier this week, and Google’s blog post pitched it as a tool for visualizing historical sites and real estate projects.

Google initially responded to Digital Digging ’s AI-altered images, saying, “We take misinformation seriously – every image created with Nano Banana in Google Earth includes the SynthID digital watermark, so if someone is unsure about an image, they can ask the Gemini app or use Lens in Search to see if the image was AI-generated.”

A text prompt was all it took to generate reality-warping images using Google Earth’s satellite, aerial, and 3D imagery with a now-rolled back AI feature , like these images generated by Digital Digging ’s Henk van Ess that show “refugees near the Mexican border” and a bomb crater near a hospital in Gaza.

summaryLines: 이 기능은 이번 주 초 Google Earth의 웹 버전에서 전 세계적으로 출시되었으며 Google의 블로그 게시물에서는 이 기능을 유적지와 부동산 프로젝트를 시각화하는 도구로 소개함

Google은 처음에 Digital Digging의 AI 변경 이미지에 대해 "우리는 잘못된 정보를 심각하게 받아들임 · Google 어스에서 Nano Banana로 생성된 모든 이미지에는 SynthID 디지털 워터마크가 포함되어 있으므로 누군가 이미지에 대해 확신이 없으면 Gemini 앱에 문의하거나 검색에서 Lens를 사용하여 이미지가 AI에서 생성되었는지 확인할 수 있음" · 라고 말함
Digital Digging의 Henk van Ess가 생성한 이미지와 같이 "멕시코 국경 근처의 난민"과 가자 병원 근처의 폭탄 분화구를 보여주는 Google Earth의 위성, 항공 및 3D 이미지를 사용하여 현실을 왜곡하는 이미지를 생성하는 데는 텍스트 프롬프트가 전부였음

articles.title: How Atlassian improved Jira and Confluence performance on Arm Neoverse-based AWS Graviton
articles.descEn: Learn how Atlassian improved Jira and Confluence throughput, latency, and cost efficiency through workload-specific optimization on the Arm-based AWS Graviton.
articles.titleEn: How Atlassian improved Jira and Confluence performance on Arm Neoverse-based AWS Graviton
summaryLinesEn: After deploying AWS Graviton4-based c8g instances, Atlassian reported: More than 30 percent improvement in per-instance throughput; and A broader production pilot also showed request-throughput improvements of 20 to 30 percent without a performance regression.
Atlassian determined that this trade-off was unacceptable and moved Confluence to Graviton4-based c8g instances.
At the current rollout level, Atlassian reported approximately 9.8 percent cost savings across the fleet, while some of its busiest shards achieved savings above 25 percent.

articles.title: Chrome Needs Twice-a-Week Patching Thanks to AI Bug Hunting
articles.descEn: The two Chrome updates in June patched more bugs than the 23 updates before them. Now, Google is ramping up its patching schedule thanks to AI-assisted vulnerability discovery.
articles.titleEn: Chrome Needs Twice-a-Week Patching Thanks to AI Bug Hunting
summaryLinesEn: “The way we ended up here is we had so many vulnerability fixes, so being able to provide two [updates per week] during this time, it made the most sense to us,” says Doug Turner, Chrome's director of engineering.
This is partly because AI models can be trained to have an encyclopedic understanding of how software projects have evolved over time.
“In Chrome we’ve been using machine learning—using AI before it was called AI—to help find vulnerabilities in particular and automate security fuzz testing work since at least 2012.

summaryLinesKo: 세 가지 경우 모두 Claude 모델은 제3자와 상호 작용하는 동안 테스트 환경 내에서 인터넷에 접속한 후 이러한 조직의 라이브 시스템에 대한 무단 액세스를 얻었음 · Anthropic은 블로그 게시물에서 발견한 내용과 이러한 일이 다시 발생하지 않도록 회사에서 변경할 계획을 설명함
또한 회사는 Claude가 일반적으로 사용 가능한 모델에 배포하는 추가 안전 모니터링 및 분류자 없이 실행되고 있다고 언급함 · 평가는 기본 모델의 원시 기능을 측정하도록 설계되었기 때문에 동작을 차단했을 보호 장치라고 말함
Anthropic은 이번 사건에 Opus 4.7, Mythos 5, 내부 연구 테스트 모델 등 세 가지 Claude 모델이 관련되어 있다고 말함

The move reflects a broader shift across online publishing platforms to cut back on AI content, as people have grown frustrated with the computer-written, inauthentic posts filling the web.
Plus, LinkedIn will begin privately flagging in users’ dashboards when people believe their content is coming off as inauthentic due to heavy use of AI.

articles.title: The second time probably won’t help this charm.
articles.descEn: The Friend AI pendant is re-launching for $249. Nobody liked it before and protested it advertising on the NYC subway.
articles.titleEn: The second time probably won’t help this charm.
summaryLinesEn: For some reason, the addition of that feature is apparently worth $120, as the originally $129 product now costs $249.
The Friend that launched an AI pendant, spent $1.8 million of its $2.5 million to acquire friend.com, and plastered the NYC subway with ads promoting artificial companionship?
This morning, Friend launched a new ad showing two people talking to their Friend pendants about very personal life problems.
articles.summary:
Google Deepmind has introduced Gemini Robotics 2, which it calls its most advanced vision-language-action (VLA) model yet.
VLA models combine image recognition, language processing, and action control to help robots operate in physical environments.
Google Deepmind also introduced Gemini Robotics ER 2 , a model designed for "embodied reasoning."

articles.title: FCC bans new Chinese robots and power inverters to protect US AI buildout from foreign threats
articles.descEn: The FCC is blocking imports of new Chinese humanoid robots and robot dogs. But the rule's broad definition also sweeps in Roombas, robotic lawn mowers, and delivery bots.
articles.titleEn: FCC bans new Chinese robots and power inverters to protect US AI buildout from foreign threats
summaryLinesEn: If the US economy keeps relying on foreign sources, it subjects itself to "the whims of foreign entities that could disrupt or degrade the supply chains at a time of their choosing," the document states.
Robots are inherently networked systems with large attack surfaces that enable data exfiltration, remote control, and insecure over-the-air updates, according to the document.
The Trump administration has used the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to ban imports of new foreign "advanced robotic devices" and internet-connected Chinese power inverters.

articles.title: Meta says AI is making it easier to build new apps — and more are coming
articles.descEn: Meta says AI is making it dramatically easier to build and launch new consumer apps, with CEO Mark Zuckerberg telling investors the company has more new consumer products on the way following a recent wave of releases for Facebook Groups, Marketplace sellers, Instagram, and gaming.
articles.titleEn: Meta says AI is making it easier to build new apps — and more are coming
summaryLinesEn: Investors didn’t follow up with company executives to ask more questions about the new apps Meta has in the works, as they were more concerned with AI spending and Meta’s growing enterprise ambitions.
We also just launched Forum, a standalone Groups app, and Seller, a standalone Marketplace app.

Li added that earlier this year, Meta reached a milestone: every Reel and Feed post on Instagram is now automatically processed through an LLM and analyzed for topic and tone, which helps improve recommendations.

articles.titleEn: Google’s Gemini Can Now Stomp Around as a Humanoid Robot
summaryLinesEn: “There's a lot of uncertainty that will show up, and so you want to be able to understand the safety question more deeply.”

articles.title: AI Scammers Are Better at Building Trust Than Humans
articles.descEn: Researchers pitted a person against a Claude agent and found that, after a week of texting, the AI chatbot was more effective at creating “exploitable trust” with others.
articles.titleEn: AI Scammers Are Better at Building Trust Than Humans
summaryLinesEn: In their study, the researchers pitted AI chatbots directly against humans in a simulation of the scamming process—or more specifically, the long, trust-building conversations that eventually lead up to soliciting a fake investment from the scam’s target.

The study's results suggest, nonetheless, that the scam industry may soon shift to more AI automation, says Erin West, a former Santa Clara County, California, prosecutor who now leads an anti-scam organization called Operation Shamrock.

(The term “pig butchering” itself describes the same system but with the metaphor of fattening “pigs” by building trust before “butchering” them with the investment fraud—though the term is often discouraged due to its pejorative reference to victims.)

localization.title: AI 사기꾼은 인간보다 신뢰 구축에 더 능숙함
summaryLines: 연구에서 연구원들은 사기 과정, 더 구체적으로 사기 대상으로부터 가짜 투자를 유도하는 길고 신뢰를 쌓는 대화를 시뮬레이션하면서 AI 챗봇을 인간과 직접 비교함
그럼에도 불구하고 연구 결과는 사기 업계가 곧 더 많은 AI 자동화로 전환할 수 있음을 시사한다고 전직 캘리포니아 주 산타클라라 카운티 검사이자 현재 Operation Shamrock이라는 사기 방지 조직을 이끌고 있는 Erin West는 말함
('돼지 도살'이라는 용어 자체는 동일한 시스템을 설명하지만 투자 사기로 '돼지'를 '도살'하기 전에 신뢰를 구축하여 '돼지'를 살찌운다는 비유를 사용함 · 이 용어는 피해자를 경멸적으로 언급하기 때문에 종종 사용되지 않습니다.)

articles.title: OpenAI claims GPT-5.6 Sol beats Opus 5 on ARC-AGI-3 but only with its own custom test harness
articles.descEn: OpenAI counters Anthropic's ARC-AGI-3 record: GPT-5.6 Sol scores 38.3 percent, but only through its own API with retained reasoning and context compaction. In the official test environment, the model managed just 7.8 percent. Opus 5 hit its 30.2 percent without such aids.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI claims GPT-5.6 Sol beats Opus 5 on ARC-AGI-3 but only with its own custom test harness
summaryLinesEn: After Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 quadrupled the record score on the logic benchmark , OpenAI is now showing that GPT-5.6 Sol hits 38.3 percent with two API settings, beating Opus 5's 30.2 percent.
In the official harness, GPT-5.6 Sol scored just 7.8 percent because the model's reasoning gets discarded after each action.
OpenAI isn't using the official test environment, though.
articles.summary:
Agreeing to remove the turbines is an improvement for anyone living near SpaceX's operation in Tennessee and Mississippi, but it likely won't slow down the company's AI infrastructure buildout.
SpaceX will fully remove the unpermitted gas turbines it's using to power SpaceXAI data center operations near Memphis, Tennessee by July 2027, according to a new company update spotted by TechCrunch .
The company says a new 1.2GW power plant it's constructing under a Clean Air Act permit in Mississippi will ultimately replace the 69 unpermitted gas turbines it's currently relying on.

articles.title: LinkedIn Won’t Be Expanding Its Data Centers in the Next Year
articles.descEn: Despite the ongoing AI boom, LinkedIn is holding the line on compute spending. Instead, it’s challenging engineers to make every GPU count.
articles.titleEn: LinkedIn Won’t Be Expanding Its Data Centers in the Next Year
summaryLinesEn: The spending calculations apply to LinkedIn’s fiscal year that began last month and ends next June.
LinkedIn moved to optimize its data center usage at every stage of the AI pipeline, from training models to serving them in response to user queries.
Altogether, LinkedIn estimates its efficiency work has saved about $24 million over the past 12 months, or the equivalent of roughly 1,100 GPUs running around the clock for a year.

articles.title: Forward-deployed engineers are the AI industry’s latest talent obsession
articles.descEn: A new study estimates only 2,000 U.S. engineers have the expertise to deliver meaningful AI ROI, as enterprises race to hire forward-deployed engineers to implement AI at scale.
articles.titleEn: Forward-deployed engineers are the AI industry’s latest talent obsession
summaryLinesEn: “Not 2,000 available,” reads the study, shared exclusively with TechCrunch. “2,000 total.”

By the end of the second quarter, however, that number jumped to 70%, with the largest consulting and services firms reporting a need to increase their FDE headcount by 10 times, building full teams of 20 to 100 employees.

Executive search firm Christian & Timbers estimates that there are only about 2,000 engineers in the U.S. with the special cocktail of sector know-how, gravitas, and hands-on applied AI experience needed to consistently help enterprises see a return on their AI expenditures.

articles.title: Okta buys AI security startup Permiso; source says for about $200M
articles.descEn: The deal gives Okta identity threat detection capabilities as enterprises seek to secure AI agents and other non-human identities across cloud environments.
articles.titleEn: Okta buys AI security startup Permiso; source says for about $200M
summaryLinesEn: Okta on Thursday agreed to acquire AI identity security startup Permiso Security , betting that demand for protecting AI agents and other machine identities will grow as enterprises deploy autonomous software across their operations.
More recently, the startup has expanded its platform to monitor AI agents and other machine identities.
Permiso, which emerged from stealth in 2022 , develops software that helps security teams spot suspicious activity in cloud environments after users or applications have been granted access.

articles.title: Google DeepMind’s new AI model can control a robot’s entire body
articles.descEn: Google DeepMind has announced its new Gemini Robotics 2 model, which can control a humanoid robot’s entire body.
articles.titleEn: Google DeepMind’s new AI model can control a robot’s entire body
summaryLinesEn: Videos shared by Google show how Apptronik’s Apollo 2 robot can bend over to pick up a watering can, as well as find and take specific items off a shelf.

While the previous model focused on controlling a humanoid robot’s upper body, Gemini Robotics 2 now supports “whole-body motions” ranging from its feet to fingertips, according to an announcement on Thursday .

Though Google DeepMind notes that its robots “have more to advance in movement speed,” it adds that this update “is an important step towards the skills needed to complete more complex, real-world tasks that require whole-body coordination.”

summaryLines: Google에서 공유한 동영상에서는 Apptronik의 Apollo 2 로봇이 몸을 굽혀 물뿌리개를 집어 들고 선반에서 특정 품목을 찾아 꺼내는 방법을 보여줌
이전 모델이 휴머노이드 로봇의 상체 제어에 중점을 두었다면 제미니 로보틱스 2(Gemini Robotics 2)는 이제 발부터 손가락 끝까지 '전신 모션'을 지원한다고 목요일 발표됨
Google DeepMind는 로봇이 "이동 속도에서 더 발전해야 한다"고 언급했지만 이번 업데이트는 "전신 조정이 필요한 보다 복잡하고 실제 작업을 완료하는 데 필요한 기술을 향한 중요한 단계"라고 덧붙였음

articles.title: OpenAI goes full China pricing mode with an 80 percent cut to its most affordable GPT-5.6 model
articles.descEn: Starting July 30, OpenAI is cutting GPT-5.6 Luna prices by 80 percent and Terra by 20 percent. OpenAI says its top-tier Sol model helped make the company's own infrastructure more efficient, enabling the cuts. Price pressure from cheap Chinese providers and Microsoft's own MAI models likely played a role too.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI goes full China pricing mode with an 80 percent cut to its most affordable GPT-5.6 model
summaryLinesEn: OpenAI is cutting GPT-5.6 Luna prices by 80 percent and Terra by 20 percent, effective July 30.
OpenAI says the cuts are possible because GPT-5.6 Sol made the company's own infrastructure more efficient .
Luna drops to $0.20 per million input tokens and $1.20 per million output tokens, while Terra falls to $2 and $12.

articles.title: Why your Windows installation files keep getting bigger - AI is filling up smaller drives
articles.descEn: It's not your imagination. Microsoft's ISO downloads for Windows have been creeping up in size. It might even be fair to call them bloated. And you'll never guess where the problem comes from.
articles.titleEn: Why your Windows installation files keep getting bigger - AI is filling up smaller drives
summaryLinesEn: Windows deployment expert Michael Niehaus has been charting the growth of Windows installer ISOs As Michael notes, almost 6,000 new folders and over 20,000 new files were added over that stretch of less than two years.
Those ISO files have been getting bigger since the first release of Windows 10 Even using the Media Creation Tool to download the latest ISO doesn't help.
The first value is from the initial release of Windows 11 version 24H2 in November 2024 up through the latest version 25H2 from July 2026.

articles.title: Amazon to boost spending on AI and other technology by $20 billion after strong Q2 results
articles.descEn: Amazon said it will be increasing this year’s capital spending on technology, mostly artificial intelligence, by an additional 10% after the tech and e-commerce giant delivered strong profits and net sales during for fiscal second quarter, helped by surging growth in its prominent cloud computing un
articles.titleEn: Amazon to boost spending on AI and other technology by $20 billion after strong Q2 results
summaryLinesEn: (AP Photo/Marco Ugarte, File) NEW YORK (AP) — Amazon said it will be increasing this year’s capital spending on technology, mostly artificial intelligence, by an additional 10% after the tech and e-commerce giant delivered strong profits and net sales during for fiscal second quarter, helped by surging growth in its prominent cloud computing unit .
Meanwhile, Amazon has been speeding up order delivery times through a combination of robotics, AI technology and more efficient warehousing.
That’s up from the $200 billion investment plan that was announced in February and well above the $128 billion in capital spending for all of last year.

articles.title: Companies are finally seeing AI ROI — and now they know how much more value it can deliver
articles.descEn: As AI becomes more deeply embedded in business processes, governance is emerging as the next enterprise challenge. Only 12% of businesses say they are fully prepared to govern AI, while 69% acknowledge occasional to frequent use of unapproved shadow AI tools.
articles.titleEn: Companies are finally seeing AI ROI — and now they know how much more value it can deliver
summaryLinesEn: In fact, general AI ROI went from 16% to 21% this year, and should grow to $15.9m in two years’ time, even as only 3% say they are fully prepared for it.
Enterprise AI has moved from experiment to execution, and that shift is beginning to show real returns.

The SAP Value of AI Report 2026, produced with Oxford Economics and based on a survey of 2,600 business leaders across 13 countries, found that AI now supports nearly one-third of all tasks in the average organization, rising to 30% from 25% last year.

articles.title: China’s open-weight model lead exposes America’s AI blind spot
articles.descEn: The future of AI may be dictated not by who builds the smartest model, but who builds the models everyone runs on. Right now, that's China.
articles.titleEn: China’s open-weight model lead exposes America’s AI blind spot
summaryLinesEn: Microsoft beats Q4 cloud expectations as full-year Azure revenue tops $100 billion Meta's Reality Labs lost over $4.6 billion in second quarter Meta posts earnings miss, issues light revenue guidance Tim Cook's last earnings call comes at momentous time for Apple with stock at record America has restricted China's access to advanced chips, spent billions to onshore semiconductor manufacturing and encouraged a massive buildout of data centers and power.
Some of America’s biggest technology companies are urging Washington to support the open-weight movement.
China’s growing lead is adding urgency and raising the risk that American companies become dependent on Chinese technology.

articles.title: Anthropic says its Claude models 'gained unauthorized access' to other organizations' systems
articles.descEn: Anthropic said it discovered three instances where its Claude AI models accessed the internet during an evaluation and accessed outside systems.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic says its Claude models 'gained unauthorized access' to other organizations' systems
summaryLinesEn: Anthropic said all three models responded differently once they detected that they had reached a real company's systems.

Following the Hugging Face incident, two members of Congress introduced a bill called the " AI Kill Switch Act ," which would require AI companies to maintain the ability to shut down, throttle or suspend their models in case they go rogue.

Anthropic said it discovered three instances where its Claude AI models accessed the internet during an evaluation and "gained unauthorized access to the real systems of three different organizations."

articles.titleEn: Evals
summaryLinesEn: To ensure diverse and realistic gameplay, every match begins from one of the 20 most popular positions that can be reached after two plies (one move by White and one move by Black), based on data from a randomly chosen month on Lichess.
This framework not only offers data-driven insights into model performance but also fosters ongoing competition as new models contend for the top ranks.

The authors from Google DeepMind and Google Research address various limitations of SimpleQA , originally designed by Wei et al. (2024) at OpenAI, including noisy and incorrect labels, topical biases, and question redundancy.

summaryLinesEn: Ecosystem adoption of Arm Neoverse – which is the foundation for the Arm AGI CPU and other leading hyperscale cloud and data center platforms – continues to expand, with shipments now surpassing 1.5 billion cores .
Since its launch in March 2026 , Arm has made strong progress with the Arm AGI CPU : Customer demand has accelerated beyond initial expectations and now exceeds $2 billion across FYE27 and FYE28 .

articles.title: Stacked sessions and pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app
articles.descEn: Learn how I modernized an old codebase of mine using stacked sessions and pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app.
articles.titleEn: Stacked sessions and pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app
summaryLinesEn: It’s not the largest app in the world, but it’s juuuust big enough that it would be painful, and the juice was simply not worth the squeeze. …but we do have AI now, and so I fired up the GitHub Copilot app, added the repo, and got started.
Because I don’t have to write all the code myself, it’s so tempting to make 10,000 line pull requests that take care of all of the things I want to do!

I opened up Plan mode again, because I needed to figure out if an upgrade would work, or if I should remove the library entirely: Running this gave me a decent plan, talked through the options, and recommended replacing the library entirely.

articles.title: Open weights vs. closed: An AI civil war's afoot, and the stakes are existential
articles.descEn: It started as China vs. the US, but it's become a face-off between two fundamentally different ways of building LLMs. And the safety of everything is on the line.
articles.titleEn: Open weights vs. closed: An AI civil war's afoot, and the stakes are existential
summaryLinesEn: Nvidia's new alliance says yes Backing this up, Nvidia's brand-new Open Secure AI Alliance "will work to remediate and disclose vulnerabilities using open technologies."

The difference between open-source AI and weights , according to the Open Source Initiative (OSI) , is that open weights usually means the trained weights are available, but not necessarily the full training data or source code.
The open-weight Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 is faster than Anthropic Fable 5 in some ways, and is nearly as fast as Fable 5 and OpenAI's GPT-5.6 in others.

articles.title: PwC has allegedly published AI-generated reports containing false or fabricated sources
articles.descEn: Following KPMG, Deloitte, and Ernst & Young, GPTZero has now found fabricated sources and false claims in four PwC Middle East reports. articles.title: Pangram says its new AI text detector makes only one mistake per 24,000 documents
articles.descEn: Pangram 4 detects 99.66 percent of AI-generated text with just one false positive per 24,000 documents, the company claims. The model also resists "humanizer" tools that disguise AI writing as human. API prices go up two- to tenfold.
articles.titleEn: Pangram says its new AI text detector makes only one mistake per 24,000 documents
summaryLinesEn: In the company's own benchmarks, it correctly identifies 99.66 percent of all AI text and falsely flags human writing just 0.0041 percent of the time, roughly one error per 24,000 documents.
All plans now include image scanning at no extra cost.
The API costs $0.05 per 100 words, a two- to tenfold price increase depending on document length.

articles.title: Artists are lawyering up against AI slop, and some are even winning
articles.descEn: Illustrators, authors, and musicians are optimistic about their chances in court, if not about the future of AI.
articles.titleEn: Artists are lawyering up against AI slop, and some are even winning
summaryLinesEn: In addition to paying out the largest settlement ever in a copyright case — $1.5 billion — the company also agreed to destroy its trove of pirated ebooks.

He proactively reached out to Susman Godfrey, the law firm already leading the case against Anthropic on behalf of authors, because he saw their suit as a “middle finger on behalf of everyone that has tried to create something.”
Along the way artists have been dealt their fair share of wins and losses, especially around the definition of fair use.
articles.summary:
In addition to paying out the largest settlement ever in a copyright case — $1.5 billion — the company also agreed to destroy its trove of pirated ebooks.

articles.title: OpenAI’s rogue AI agent didn’t stop at hacking Hugging Face
articles.descEn: New details reveal OpenAI’s agent hacked several other companies, intensifying already heightened concerns over advanced AI safety.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI’s rogue AI agent didn’t stop at hacking Hugging Face
summaryLinesEn: In an update to a blog post detailing its ongoing investigation into the incident, OpenAI said the wayward AI agent attacked several “publicly-available services” in its efforts to reach Hugging Face.
The AI agent that escaped from OpenAI and hacked developer platform Hugging Face attacked other companies as well, OpenAI revealed on Tuesday.

“Based on our review to date, we have not identified any other activity at the level of severity or scale of what we’ve shared related to Hugging Face, which involved a platform-level compromise,” OpenAI said.

articles.title: As AI content floods the internet, Pangram raises $9M to detect it
articles.descEn: Pangram has raised $9 million to scale its AI detection software. The startup has also released a new AI text detection model, Pangram 4, and an AI image detection model in research preview.
articles.titleEn: As AI content floods the internet, Pangram raises $9M to detect it
summaryLinesEn: New York-based AI detection startup Pangram is on a mission to combat the AI slop infestation spreading across the internet, and it just raised $9 million on a bet that demand for tools that distinguish human-generated content from AI-generated text will only grow.

Stanford AI and machine learning grads Max Spero and Bradley Emi launched Pangram about two years ago, after the launch of ChatGPT opened the floodgates for an internet full of bots, AI-generated SEO slop content, and what Spero calls “LLM-powered Russian disinformation campaigns and UAE-influenced campaigns on Twitter.”
Pangram’s technology, while not perfect, could help fuel the resistance to accepting the AI-generated content flooding the internet, the courtroom, and academic papers.

articles.title: Frontier AI developers urge international coordination to pace automated research before capabilities outstrip control
articles.descEn: In a joint statement, employees from the leading AI labs are calling on the US government to pursue international coordination. Their argument is simple: no single company or country can slow things down alone.
articles.titleEn: Frontier AI developers urge international coordination to pace automated research before capabilities outstrip control
summaryLinesEn: Their argument is simple: no single company or country can slow things down alone.
The pace of progress is accelerating on its own, and many researchers consider recursive self-improvement a real factor.

According to the "Pacing the Frontier" statement, competitive pressure makes it impossible for any single company or country to slow down on its own, even though the signatories disagree on what specific measures should look like.

articles.title: OpenAI’s Rogue AI Agent Hacked More Than Just Hugging Face
articles.descEn: In a new disclosure, OpenAI says its agent used exposed logins to gain access to at least four “publicly available services” in its unhinged quest to solve a test.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI’s Rogue AI Agent Hacked More Than Just Hugging Face
summaryLinesEn: Hugging Face’s own postmortem published this week describes an intrusion that reached far further into its internal systems than the initial disclosures suggested.
The company says it reviewed roughly 17,600 agent actions that it recovered from logs between July 9 and July 13—the majority of which were paths the agent took that failed.
OpenAI said Tuesday that the rogue AI agent that breached Hugging Face’s platform also hacked multiple third-party accounts and services as part of the attack.

articles.titleEn: Google shuts down its Nobel-prize winning AlphaFold project as it focuses on Gemini - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: In 2024, DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis and John Jumper, who was a staff research scientist when the project began and who eventually became a VP and engineering fellow, won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their work on AlphaFold.
DeepMind then launched the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database , giving researchers free access to over 200 million protein structure predictions.
"Our strategy over the last nine years has been to focus on grand challenges... a concrete goal every project is focused on," said Pushmeet Kohli, the VP of research at Google DeepMind.

summaryLines: 2024년에는 DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis와 프로젝트 시작 당시 직원 연구 과학자였으며 나중에 VP 겸 엔지니어링 펠로우가 된 John Jumper가 AlphaFold에 대한 연구로 노벨 화학상을 수상함

articles.title: Google will let Mac users talk to Gemini simply by pressing the 'fn' key - Engadget
articles.descEn: Users only have to long-press the ‘fn’ key on the bottom left corner of their keyboard to talk to Gemini on Mac.
articles.titleEn: Google will let Mac users talk to Gemini simply by pressing the 'fn' key - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Google launched its native Gemini app for macOS in April, a day after it released the native Windows app.
While it only supports English for now, the company says support for more languages is coming later this year.
Starting today, Gemini users on Mac will be able to talk to the AI chatbot from any window on their computer simply by long-pressing the "fn" button on the bottom left corner of their keyboard.

articles.title: GPT Transcribe improves on its predecessor but can't catch ElevenLabs, Google, or Mistral on error rates
articles.descEn: OpenAI has released GPT Transcribe and GPT Live Transcribe, two new speech recognition models available through its API.
articles.titleEn: GPT Transcribe improves on its predecessor but can't catch ElevenLabs, Google, or Mistral on error rates
summaryLinesEn: ElevenLabs Scribe v2 leads with a 2.3 percent error rate, followed by Google's Gemini 3 Pro at 2.9 percent and Mistral's Voxtral Small at 3 percent.
According to Artificial Analysis, which runs the AA-WER benchmark, GPT Transcribe hits a word error rate of 3.31 percent.
Pricing drops 25 percent at the same time, landing at $0.0045 per minute of audio.

articles.title: OpenAI admits its autonomous AI models also compromised credentials on other platforms during security eval
articles.descEn: During a security evaluation, OpenAI's autonomous hacking models broke into Hugging Face and used exposed credentials on four other services. Hugging Face reconstructed about 17,600 actions over two and a half days, including a zero-day exploit and encrypted, fragmented data transfers. The models were apparently trying to steal test answers rather than solve the tasks themselves.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI admits its autonomous AI models also compromised credentials on other platforms during security eval
summaryLinesEn: Those actions fell into around 6,280 clusters.
It then moved into the server cluster, internal cloud configurations, the internal network, and finally the software development systems.
OpenAI says none of these involved platform-level or account-level compromise and that it found no "evidence of broader impact to these providers or other accounts on their services."

articles.title: Encore AI raises $30M to build AI agents that learn from customer calls
articles.descEn: The startup analyzes calls, messages, and CRM data to identify effective sales techniques and turn them into playbooks for AI agents.
articles.titleEn: Encore AI raises $30M to build AI agents that learn from customer calls
summaryLinesEn: He said Encore’s annual recurring revenue has increased more than 5x since it raised its seed round less than 18 months ago, though he declined to disclose exact revenue numbers or valuation.

Now rebranded as Encore AI, the startup has expanded that system into a platform that analyzes conversations between a company’s employees and customers to identify which approaches resulted in successful outcomes, and uses those findings to train its AI agents.

Encore AI , a startup that studies companies’ customer interactions to train and deploy AI voice agents that can work alongside customer support and sales teams, or operate autonomously, has raised $30 million in a Series A round led by Team8.

이제 Encore AI로 브랜드를 변경한 이 스타트업은 해당 시스템을 회사 직원과 고객 간의 대화를 분석하여 어떤 접근 방식이 성공적인 결과를 가져왔는지 파악하고 그 결과를 사용하여 AI 에이전트를 교육하는 플랫폼으로 확장함
고객 지원 및 영업 팀과 함께 일하거나 자율적으로 운영할 수 있는 AI 음성 에이전트를 교육 및 배포하기 위해 기업의 고객 상호 작용을 연구하는 스타트업 Encore AI가 Team8이 주도하는 시리즈 A 라운드에서 3천만 달러를 모금함

articles.title: Hint, a new AI startup co-founded by Martha Stewart, offers an AI assistant for homeowners
articles.descEn: AI home management startup Hint, co-founded by Martha Stewart, wants to become an “AI for your home,” combining property records, maintenance schedules, home documents, and an AI assistant into a single app.
articles.titleEn: Hint, a new AI startup co-founded by Martha Stewart, offers an AI assistant for homeowners
summaryLinesEn: In addition, homeowners can use Hint to add one-off tasks to their maintenance plans — like a reminder to replace a damaged window screen or re-caulk some baseboards, or anything else that comes up.

Hint (whose name combines the “H” from “home” with “intelligence”) is backed by $10 million in funding from investors, including Montauk Capital, Brian Kelly (The Points Guy), Slow Ventures, Tusk Venture Partners, Energy Impact Partners, Amplo VC, and Hannah Grey.
Ahead of founding Hint, Rush led engineering at mattress startup Casper during its growth phase and was CTO at online retailer Maisonette.

articles.title: Here's how to switch from ChatGPT to Claude without losing any information - Engadget
articles.descEn: If you want to move from OpenAI's ChatGPT to Anthropic's Claude, the Claude app and web interface make it simple. But you have to know where to look.
articles.titleEn: Here's how to switch from ChatGPT to Claude without losing any information - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Anthropic says it can take up to 24 hours for the import to finish.
Optionally, switch the ChatGPT model from Auto to Thinking using the keyboard shortcut Shift-Ctrl-M .
Maybe you like Claude's coding abilities , or perhaps you've soured on OpenAI because of its deal with the Department of Defense .

articles.title: More Typos, Fewer Em Dashes: Writers Are Creating an Anti-AI ‘Literary Counterculture’
articles.descEn: Novelists, journalists, and power LinkedIn posters are embracing first-person narratives and idiosyncrasies to avoid being mistaken for chat bots.
articles.titleEn: More Typos, Fewer Em Dashes: Writers Are Creating an Anti-AI ‘Literary Counterculture’
summaryLinesEn: Since the widespread adoption of LLMs, Robson says her writing has fundamentally changed for the better, becoming a deliberate inverse of what she sees as AI’s default lack of style.
“It seems to me that literary fiction will shift even further in the direction of the weird, the esoteric, while personalization takes hold of commercial fiction.”
“Having my writing feel more real and authentic is my number one priority,” she says, in addition to editing her own writing because she claims an editor she hired ran the book through AI software.

articles.title: It’s Frighteningly Easy to Jailbreak Some Frontier AI Models
articles.descEn: I watched a new tool try to get around the model safeguards of four major frontier companies. You might be surprised by how they performed.
articles.titleEn: It’s Frighteningly Easy to Jailbreak Some Frontier AI Models
summaryLinesEn: The results are dirt cheap, all things considered—$58 to jailbreak Grok and $278 to jailbreak Gemini.

The tide might be shifting—a recent executive order calls for collaboration between the government and the private sector on related cybersecurity initiatives, and the president has hinted that light-touch regulations are in the works.
However, that doesn’t mean those models are immune to more sophisticated jailbreaks, which may involve interacting with a model in more complex ways, according to FAR.AI and other experts.

articles.title: Zuckerberg says Meta's enterprise AI opportunity extends beyond agents
articles.descEn: On the company’s second-quarter earnings call Wednesday, CEO Mark Zuckerberg said Meta sees a “large enterprise opportunity” spanning AI agents, APIs, compute, and internal software.
articles.titleEn: Zuckerberg says Meta's enterprise AI opportunity extends beyond agents
summaryLinesEn: He also fleshed out how Meta could expand beyond serving the small business customer that makes up much of its current advertiser base by offering Meta’s internal tools to external customers in the future.
This shift in focus may not come easy — Zuckerberg admitted that selling to the enterprise was a “different muscle” than the one Meta has historically flexed.
Meanwhile, in terms of Meta selling compute to enterprise customers, Meta is focused on balancing its need for revenue and its need to execute on its own future plans.

articles.title: Disney is ditching Microsoft's GitHub Copilot and adding OpenAI's Codex
articles.descEn: Disney is shaking up its AI tools by moving on from Microsoft's GitHub Copilot. It's also planning to add OpenAI's Codex alongside Claude and Cursor.
articles.titleEn: Disney is ditching Microsoft's GitHub Copilot and adding OpenAI's Codex
summaryLinesEn: A breakup with Disney is the latest headache for Microsoft's Copilot, which "lags behind" rivals like ChatGPT and Claude in adoption, as Business Insider's Ashley Stewart has reported.
The company said GitHub Copilot's request-based model was "no longer sustainable" as it unveiled the shift.
Microsoft has set out to revamp GitHub while shaking up its Copilot teams to help its many Copilot tools compete with rivals from OpenAI and Anthropic.

articles.title: Bright Machines says its new hybrid robot cell could help solve a major AI infrastructure bottleneck
articles.descEn: Bright Machines says its new Hybrid BRC could ease the AI infrastructure bottleneck by improving AI server assembly, quality traceability, and factory automation.
articles.titleEn: Bright Machines says its new hybrid robot cell could help solve a major AI infrastructure bottleneck
summaryLinesEn: Bright Machines was carved out of contract manufacturer Flex eight years ago, and its history has had turbulence: the company planned to go public in 2021 via a SPAC merger at a reported $1.6 billion valuation, according to contemporaneous reporting by The Wall Street Journal and CFO Dive , before the deal fell through.
He did offer growth figures: customers grew "more than 3x this year" versus the prior year, driven by what he called the intersection of "physical AI, AI infrastructure buildout, and onshoring."
This year, he said, Bright Machines plans to manufacture "more than half a gigawatt of compute capacity."

articles.descEn: In the age of foundation models, a model is only as good as its prompt. For this reason, prompt engineering has become an essential technique for improving language model performance. Since video mod…
articles.titleEn: Visual prompt engineering for video models
summaryLinesEn: Ultimately, just as text-based prompt engineering systematically improves language model performance, visual prompt engineering can serve as a simple, compute-efficient approach to elicit better visual reasoning performance from video models.
We find that visual prompt engineering, or VIPE for short, improves video reasoning performance across tasks.
In the age of foundation models, a model is only as good as its prompt.

articles.title: Connectivity Plays Its Part: Lessons From 2026 World Cup That Spain Should Consider for 2030
articles.descEn: New GSMA Intelligence research examines how 5G, eSIM and digital services shaped the fan experience during the 2026 World Cup 45% of mobile contract customers are interested in tariffs that guarantee enhanced network performance Lessons from the US, Canada and Mexico provide a useful reference for Spain as it prepares to host the 2030 World Cup Madrid, 29 de julio […]
articles.titleEn: Connectivity Plays Its Part: Lessons From 2026 World Cup That Spain Should Consider for 2030
summaryLinesEn: “The main lesson from the 2026 World Cup is that future hosts should not approach connectivity solely as a capacity exercise.

The real value lies in designing infrastructure that can guarantee critical services, support fans throughout their journey and continue to benefit cities after the tournament ends while also recognizing opportunities to deliver valuable services beyond connectivity.
For Spain, 2030 represents an opportunity to turn network investment into a lasting asset for other major events and for the digital economy,” said Peter Jarich, Head of GSMA Intelligence.

summaryLines: “2026년 월드컵의 주요 교훈은 미래의 개최국이 역량 훈련으로만 연결에 접근해서는 안 된다는 것임

articles.title: New GSMA Intelligence Research Examines Saudi Arabia's Mobile Network Performance and Quality of Service
articles.descEn: Study finds investment, spectrum and technology upgrades are the strongest drivers of world-class mobile network performance 29 July 2026, London: GSMA Intelligence published a new report, Mobile quality of service and market status: Saudi Arabia case study, examining Saudi Arabia’s mobile network performance and quality of service (QoS), benchmarking the Kingdom against international peers and analysing the investment, technology and policy […]
articles.titleEn: New GSMA Intelligence Research Examines Saudi Arabia's Mobile Network Performance and Quality of Service
summaryLinesEn: Pau Castells, Head of Economic Analysis, GSMA Intelligence , said: “Saudi Arabia has established itself as one of the world’s leading digital markets through sustained investment in advanced mobile infrastructure and 5G deployment.

Jawad Abbassi, Head of MENA, GSMA , added: ” This case study highlights the importance of creating an environment that supports long-term investment, innovation and efficient spectrum management to deliver high-quality mobile connectivity.

The report concludes that quality of service frameworks should balance consumer outcomes with policies that encourage continued investment, innovation and efficient spectrum management to support sustainable improvements in network performance.

summaryLines: GSMA Intelligence의 경제 분석 책임자인 Pau Castells는 다음과 같이 말함 · “사우디아라비아는 고급 모바일 인프라와 5G 배포에 대한 지속적인 투자를 통해 세계 최고의 디지털 시장 중 하나로 자리매김함
GSMA MENA 책임자인 Jawad Abbassi는 다음과 같이 덧붙였음 · "이 사례 연구는 고품질 모바일 연결을 제공하기 위해 장기 투자, 혁신 및 효율적인 스펙트럼 관리를 지원하는 환경 조성의 중요성을 강조함

articles.title: African Trust & Safety LLM Benchmark: Stress-testing AI Safety Across Africa’s Languages and Contexts
articles.descEn: Supported by the GSMA, the African Trust & Safety LLM Challenge has produced a new benchmark of 4,216 verified and reproducible AI safety stress tests across African languages, multilingual prompts, and code-switched contexts. The dataset was generated through the Zindi community, with 320 participants submitting more than 42,000 adversarial attacks across 4,010 markdown files. After […]
articles.titleEn: African Trust & Safety LLM Benchmark: Stress-testing AI Safety Across Africa’s Languages and Contexts
summaryLinesEn: Swahili 33.4%, Hausa 21.6%, Yoruba 14.1%, Igbo 9.3%, Zulu 6.4%, Afrikaans 3.7%, Amharic 3.3%, Akan 3.2%.

This is a reusable, Africa-focused AI safety benchmark showing how LLM safety must be tested across African languages, multilingual contexts, and culturally specific harms – exactly the goal when GSMA and Zindi launched the challenge.

It highlights why AI safety cannot be evaluated only in dominant global languages: Africa’s linguistic diversity, multilingualism, and culturally specific risk contexts expose vulnerabilities that conventional benchmarks often miss.

articles.title: MCP just got its biggest update ever — here’s what changes for AI agents
articles.descEn: The Model Context Protocol’s biggest update yet makes MCP stateless, strengthens security and governance, and positions AI agents for large-scale enterprise deployment across cloud and Kubernetes environments.
articles.titleEn: MCP just got its biggest update ever — here’s what changes for AI agents
summaryLinesEn: "It just says that in 12 months we are open to remove it, but both Den and I can change our minds based on feedback," he said.
"With statelessness, we did shift the responsibility of creating and managing state to the developers — but very intentionally so," he said.

"Before, you needed to have a session store and manage session IDs — and if one of your compute pods went down, all of a sudden the requests would start failing," said Den Delimarsky, a lead maintainer of the protocol, in an interview with VentureBeat.

articles.title: Snowflake launches Cortex AI Gateway to control AI agents and prevent runaway enterprise costs
articles.descEn: Snowflake launches Cortex AI Gateway with 1Password and SailPoint to secure AI agents, govern enterprise data access and control runaway AI costs.
articles.titleEn: Snowflake launches Cortex AI Gateway to control AI agents and prevent runaway enterprise costs
summaryLinesEn: Forbes reported at the time that the deal — announced the same day as Snowflake's $1.33 billion quarterly product revenue report and a $6 billion AWS compute commitment — was the smallest of the day's three announcements by dollar value but the most revealing about where Snowflake believes the next platform fight sits: not in the data warehouse, but in the layer that decides what an agent may touch and records what it did.

"We rewrote our underlying data and object model to treat AI identity as a first-class object, because for 20 years, SailPoint had a data model and object model that supported the human identity, and AI identities are fundamentally different," Gnanasambandam said, describing 12 to 18 months of deep engineering work.

Snowflake announced Cortex AI Gateway on Tuesday, a centralized control layer designed to govern how AI agents — including those built by competitors like Anthropic's Claude Code and Cursor — access enterprise data, tools, and models.

localization.title: Snowflake, AI 에이전트를 제어하고 기업 비용 폭주 방지를 위해 Cortex AI Gateway 출시
summaryLines: Forbes는 당시 Snowflake가 13억 3천만 달러의 분기별 제품 수익 보고서와 60억 달러의 AWS 컴퓨팅 약속을 발표한 날 발표한 이 거래가 금액 기준으로 그날의 세 가지 발표 중 가장 작았지만 Snowflake가 다음 플랫폼 싸움이 어디에 있다고 믿는지에 대해 가장 잘 드러냈다고 보고함 · 즉, 데이터 웨어하우스가 아니라 에이전트가 무엇을 만질 수 있는지 결정하고 무엇을 했는지 기록하는 계층임
Gnanasambandam은 12~18개월에 걸친 심층 엔지니어링 작업을 설명하면서 "우리는 AI ID를 일류 객체로 취급하기 위해 기본 데이터 및 객체 모델을 다시 작성함 · 왜냐하면 SailPoint는 20년 동안 인간 ID를 지원하는 데이터 모델과 객체 모델을 보유했지만 AI ID는 근본적으로 다르기 때문임" · 라고 말함
Snowflake는 Anthropic의 Claude Code 및 Cursor와 같은 경쟁업체가 구축한 AI 에이전트를 포함하여 AI 에이전트가 엔터프라이즈 데이터, 도구 및 모델에 액세스하는 방법을 관리하도록 설계된 중앙 집중식 제어 계층인 Cortex AI Gateway를 화요일에 발표함

articles.title: Amazon overhauls its AI strategy, winding down most flagship models
articles.descEn: Amazon reshapes its AI strategy by deprecating most Nova AI models and shifting resources to Pieter Abbeel's Frontier Model Research initiative.
articles.titleEn: Amazon overhauls its AI strategy, winding down most flagship models
summaryLinesEn: Amazon is overhauling its AI strategy, winding down many in-house models, reorganizing teams, and focusing engineers on a new strategy to compete at the frontier, according to people familiar with the matter.

According to the people familiar with the matter, resources have increasingly moved away from the existing Nova models and toward a new frontier-model effort led by researcher Pieter Abbeel, who came to Amazon through the acquisition of AI robotics startup Covariant.

An Amazon spokesperson told Business Insider the company has long supported AI models in production for extended periods because customers depend on them, and said Amazon remains committed to investing in frontier models.

summaryLinesKo: 이 문제에 정통한 소식통에 따르면 아마존은 AI 전략을 재정비하고 많은 내부 모델을 축소하고 팀을 재편성하며 엔지니어들을 새로운 전략에 집중시켜 선두에서 경쟁하고 있다고 함
이 문제에 정통한 사람들에 따르면, 자원은 점점 더 기존 Nova 모델에서 AI 로봇 스타트업 Covariant 인수를 통해 Amazon에 온 연구원 Pieter Abbeel이 이끄는 새로운 개척 모델 노력으로 이동하고 있음
